payload.description:
As a scanner engineer, I want to run plexus evaluate accuracy against the local GraphQL server with the detector score, so that I can compare recall to a previous evaluation with --baseline.

Gherkin (draft):

Feature: Scanner recall evaluation

  Scenario: Evaluate gold detections
    Given a local Plexus GraphQL server
    And gold annotations loaded as Items labeled Yes
    And the detector Score is on the scorecard
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for that score
    Then an Evaluation record is stored
    And the headline metric is recall of detections

  Scenario: Compare to a prior run
    Given a previous Evaluation id
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy --baseline that id
    Then the new Evaluation is comparable to the baseline
payload.title: Recall evaluation via plexus evaluate accuracy CLI
